summary: Independent initial canonical audit pinned to Jiuwudaishi 090 source and extraction. Read all 340 Chinese units and checked all 562 temporal or active-hint items and 154 people. The source supports the broad chronology and event ownership throughout, but eight vague era expressions are incorrectly serialized as exact Western years across their related claims, and two anonymous-person active hints fabricate AD 920 from a source that supplies only an interval. Three source-explicit undated records remain valid research holds. Repair the identified date precision and hint records, preserve the three holds without inventing dates, then obtain a fresh independent audit.
